mapper.select: INSERT INTO hook_plans (row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, promise, conflict, curiosity_question, visual_hook, dialogue_hook, withheld_information, payoff_beat_id) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{chapterId}, #{promise}, #{conflict}, #{curiosityQuestion}, #{visualHook}, #{dialogueHook}, #{withheldInformation}, #{payoffBeatId}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE hook_plans SET promise = #{promise}, conflict = #{conflict}, curiosity_question = #{curiosityQuestion}, visual_hook = #{visualHook}, dialogue_hook = #{dialogueHook}, withheld_information = #{withheldInformation}, payoff_beat_id = #{payoffBeatId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
